model: Typed graph + nested cells + orthogonal coordinates + integrated projection registry + two-field Potato projection. Hypercube remains a useful intuition for independent directions, but the House is not assigned one literal Euclidean embedding.

eight_coordinate_address.question: Which operative frame is active?
eight_coordinate_address.meaning: scale, representation, jurisdiction, time slice, audience

eight_coordinate_address.question: What broader integration or criterion does this point toward?
What supports, precedes, causes or evidences this?
What unfolds or results from this?
How does this change state or context?

macro_roles.note: Project meaning/identity core; centrality is compositional, not truth rank.
Runs DOWN through every source-bearing Room as provenance and evidence roots.
Runs through every changing subject as occurrence, attestation and interpretation time.
Translates between project comparison and traditions on their own historical/textual terms.
Turns candidate structure into explicit models, tests and scientific/formal boundaries.
Keeps organism/body reality and symbolic body comparison distinguishable.
Projects relation-first work into observable institutions, economies, places and infrastructure.
Tracks how meaning moves through media, platforms, subcultures and public discourse.
Creative outputs are Fruit/Artifacts without automatically becoming doctrine or evidence.
Crosses all Rooms as a provisional frontier and promotion/retirement Door.

crosscutters.function: occurrence time, attestation time, interpretation time
questions, candidate models, testing, promotion and rejection
state-transition and transformation grammar; not a Room

strong_corridors.door: symbolic body mapping ↔ empirical body record

topological_laws: Adjacency is typed: two Rooms can be near in one graph family and far in another.
Archive, Time and Research Lab are crosscutting axes rather than ordinary hallway neighbors.
Views may span many Rooms but never become owners.
The Living Axis supplies THROUGH/transition semantics across the House; it is not a new top-level Room.
Nested Rooms inherit fact-family ownership from their parent and may not silently create shadow canon.
A public route may expose several Rooms or subrooms; URL hierarchy does not define ontology.
Every strong corridor should preserve a route back to both sides' evidence and boundaries.

topological_laws.law: Prefer overlap/intersection semantics over stacked-floor semantics when the same relation is already represented by two complete fields sharing a Door.
Plane and Cross are internal coordinates/sections of the Door relation, not sequential containers before Door.
Garden/House and Swamp/Shell/Cube are functional system regimes that may occur across locations; do not pin moral state to upper/lower geometry.
UI rectangles and backend Boxes are bounded contexts, not literal geometric commitments.

embedding_contract.principle: Do not store one permanent XYZ or hypercube coordinate as truth. A Room's durable position is the tuple of containment, macro band, primary relational coordinates, crosscutting roles, typed adjacency and interfaces.
embedding_contract.hypercube_note: The eight House directions behave more like independent relational questions than eight physical axes. Hypercube imagery is acceptable as a View when it does not imply metric distance, truth rank or fixed ontology.

scale_projection.dwelling: ten canonical top-level bounded contexts; public architectural alias: Mansion
scale_projection.chamber: future/local specialist cell when a Room contains a stable smaller boundary

potato_projection.purpose: Relate the semantic House to the mature Potato geometry without making repository folders or frontend cards literal cosmological shapes.

whole.meaning: One compositional House formed by two complete overlapping relational fields.

source_field.note: Orientation only; canonical Rooms are not physically stored here.

manifestation_field.note: Not identical with Saturn/666/Cube, Swamp or Strife.

door.meaning: Shared relational/intersection field produced by genuine overlap. In the 3D lift it is a spherical lens volume.

plane.meaning: Operative/world-facing section through the widest middle of the shared Door.

axis.meaning: Source↔manifestation orientation through both field centers.

cross.meaning: Relational midpoint/event inside Door; not a Room, container or separate floor.

boundary_regimes.house_garden: protect differentiation + legitimate passage + return + repair + autonomous future growth
boundary_regimes.shell_cube: capture/compress + opaque dependency + blocked passage + high exit cost + boundary self-preservation
boundary_regimes.rule: Regime is functional; shape and vertical position do not determine moral valence.

potato_projection.ui_rule: Rectangular cards, grids and diagrams are projections only. They must never imply that Rooms are literal cubes or that the House is rectilinear.
